content_sections.text: A total of 174 Anganwadi Worker vacancies are available across different projects of Bareilly district.

content_sections.heading: Bareilly Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates interested in Bareilly Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 must complete the online application process within the dates mentioned in the official notification. The online application process is conducted through the official Anganwadi recruitment portal upanganwadibharti.in .

content_sections.heading: Bareilly Anganwadi Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process for Bareilly Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026 will be carried out according to the criteria mentioned in the official notification. Priority will be given according to the following order: Widow women from the same Gram Sabha/Ward belonging to families living below the poverty line. Divorced or deserted women from the same Gram Sabha/Ward belonging to families living below the poverty line. Widow, divorced or deserted women from other eligible categories as mentioned in the notification. If suitable candidates are not available under the above categories, selection will be considered according to the priority order mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.text: Eligible female candidates can apply online for Bareilly Anganwadi Worker Vacancy 2026 by following the steps below: Visit the official Anganwadi recruitment website. Open the Bareilly Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 application link. Complete the registration process with required details. faq.question: Q1. What is Bareilly Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Bareilly Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive conducted by the District Programme Officer, Child Development, Bareilly for Anganwadi Worker posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Bareilly Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 174 Anganwadi Worker vacancies are available in different projects of Bareilly district.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Bareilly Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate (12th) or equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q4. Who can apply for Bareilly Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only female candidates who fulfil the required eligibility criteria can apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Bareilly Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 35 years as on 01 July 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for Bareilly Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 25 August 2026.
